name: signal_mean
description: Arithmetic mean of the normalized resistance signal

name: signal_median
description: 50th percentile (median) of the normalized resistance signal

name: signal_std
description: Sample standard deviation (ddof=1) of normalized resistance signal

name: signal_var
description: Sample variance (ddof=1) of normalized resistance signal

name: signal_min
description: Minimum value of normalized resistance signal

name: signal_max
description: Maximum value of normalized resistance signal

name: signal_range
description: Full amplitude range (max - min) of normalized resistance signal

name: signal_rms
description: Root mean square of normalized resistance signal

name: signal_abs_mean
description: Mean absolute value of normalized resistance signal

name: signal_mad_mean
description: Mean absolute deviation from the mean

name: signal_mad_median
description: Median absolute deviation (MAD) from the median

name: signal_iqr
description: Interquartile range (75th - 25th percentile)

name: signal_p10
description: 10th percentile of normalized resistance signal

name: signal_p25
description: 25th percentile of normalized resistance signal

name: signal_p75
description: 75th percentile of normalized resistance signal

name: signal_p90
description: 90th percentile of normalized resistance signal

name: signal_skewness
description: Fisher-Pearson standardized skewness coefficient

name: signal_kurtosis
description: Fisher excess kurtosis (normal distribution = 0)

name: diff_mean
description: Mean of consecutive signal sample differences

name: diff_std
description: Standard deviation of consecutive signal sample differences

name: diff_abs_mean
description: Mean absolute first difference (measure of signal roughness)

name: diff_rms
description: Root mean square of consecutive signal sample differences

name: diff_abs_max
description: Maximum absolute difference between consecutive samples

name: diff2_std
description: Standard deviation of second differences (signal acceleration proxy)

name: total_variation
description: Total variation (sum of absolute differences across entire trial)

name: normalized_total_variation
description: Total variation normalized by recording duration

name: derivative_abs_mean
description: Mean absolute rate of change accounting for physical elapsed time

name: derivative_rms
description: RMS rate of change accounting for physical elapsed time

name: robust_amplitude_range
description: Robust amplitude range between 90th and 10th percentiles

name: coefficient_of_variation
description: Ratio of std to absolute mean; NaN if mean near zero

name: crest_factor
description: Ratio of peak absolute amplitude to RMS amplitude

name: zero_crossing_count
description: Number of mean-centered baseline crossings in trial

name: zero_crossing_rate
description: Baseline crossings per second of recording

name: peak_count
description: Number of prominent peaks detected on centered signal

name: peak_rate_per_sec
description: Peak count divided by recording duration

name: peak_prominence_mean
description: Mean prominence of detected peaks

name: peak_interval_mean_s
description: Mean time interval between consecutive peaks

name: peak_interval_cv
description: Coefficient of variation of inter-peak intervals (oscillation regularity)

name: dominant_frequency_hz
description: Dominant frequency within observable frequency band (0.5 to Nyquist)

name: spectral_centroid_hz
description: Center of mass of power spectrum within observable band

name: spectral_entropy
description: Normalized spectral entropy of power distribution

name: band_power_low_0_5_to_3_0_hz
description: Spectral power in low-frequency voluntary/movement band (0.5 - 3.0 Hz)

name: band_power_parkinsonian_3_0_to_5_0_hz
description: Spectral power in Parkinsonian resting tremor band (3.0 - 5.0 Hz)

name: band_power_high_5_0_to_10_0_hz
description: Spectral power in postural/action tremor band (5.0 - 10.0 Hz). Gated by Nyquist.
formula: trapz(PSD[5.0 <= f <= 10.0]) if fs >= 20.0 else NaN

name: tremor_power_ratio
description: Ratio of Parkinsonian band power (3-5 Hz) to low frequency band power (0.5-3 Hz)

name: postural_drift_slope
description: Linear drift rate over time during sustained posture

name: postural_fatigue_ratio
description: Ratio of signal RMS in second half to first half of trial

name: tap_count
description: Number of detected finger tapping events

name: tap_rate_hz
description: Finger tapping repetition frequency

name: tap_interval_mean_s
description: Average interval between consecutive finger taps

name: tap_interval_cv
description: Coefficient of variation of tap intervals (bradykinetic rhythm stability)

name: tap_amplitude_mean
description: Average amplitude of detected tap excursions

name: tap_amplitude_decrement_slope
description: Rate of decrease in tap amplitude across consecutive repetitions

name: movement_smoothness_jerk_proxy
description: Normalized jerk proxy measuring movement trajectory smoothness

name: gait_step_count_proxy
description: Number of detected gait cyclic foot-contact events
formula: count(cyclic signal excursions exceeding adaptive threshold)

name: gait_cadence_steps_per_min
description: Estimated gait cadence in steps per minute

name: postural_sway_variability
description: Standard deviation of resistance during quiet standing

name: transition_duration_s
description: Total duration of functional mobility transition
